---
name: Printer profile request
about: Ask for a printer profile (bed size and speeds) for print estimates
title: "Printer profile: <maker> <model>"
labels: printer-profile
---

**Printer:** maker and model

**Build volume (mm):** X x Y x Z, and the link to the maker's spec page

**Nozzle / filament:** e.g. 0.4 mm / 1.75 mm

**Firmware:** Klipper / Marlin / other

**Slicer speeds you use (mm/s):** outer wall, inner wall, infill, top/bottom, first layer

**Optional: one real print to calibrate:** part, layer height, infill, slicer time, real time

Guide: docs/PRINTER-PROFILES.md. Do not paste API keys or IP addresses.
